programmes.name_en: Bolsa Família cash transfer programme (successor of Auxílio Brasil)
programmes.funder: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS) / Caixa Econômica Federal
programmes.amount_note: Minimum of R$ 691 per family from the October 2026 payroll (Benefício Complementar tops up to R$ 691; was R$ 600). Composition from October 2026: R$ 164 per member (Benefício de Renda de Cidadania, was R$ 142) + R$ 173 per child aged 0 to under 7 (Benefício Primeira Infância, was R$ 150) + R$ 58 per pregnant woman, nursing mother or child/adolescent aged 7 to under 18 (Benefício Variável Familiar, was R$ 50). Decreto nº 13.120 of 17 Sep 2026 raised values 15.04%; amounts available from 19 Oct 2026.
programmes.deadline_note: Monthly payments by NIS final digit; family must keep CadÚnico updated (every 2 years) and comply with health/school conditionalities. New values apply from the October 2026 payroll (paid from 19 Oct 2026).

procedure_steps.detail: Register or update the family in the Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) at the CRAS of your municipality
MDS selects eligible families automatically from CadÚnico data; check status in the Bolsa Família/Caixa Tem app
Receive monthly payment via Caixa Tem app, Bolsa Família card or Caixa branches

documents_required.doc: CPF or identity document of the family representative
Documents of all family members (CPF/birth certificate)

eligibility.income_note: Per capita family income up to R$ 218 per month (official MDS page); R$ 218 x 12 = R$ 2,616 per person per year (per-capita figure, not household total). Family must be registered in CadÚnico.

programmes.source_snippet: O Benefício Complementar garante que a soma das parcelas recebidas pela família não fique abaixo de R$ 691.

programmes.name_en: Continuous Benefit Payment (BPC) - social assistance pension for elderly 65+ and persons with disabilities
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (MDS), operado pelo INSS
programmes.amount_note: One national minimum wage per month (R$ 1.621 in 2026). No 13th salary and no survivor's pension.
programmes.deadline_note: Requires CadÚnico updated within the last 2 years; review every 2 years.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS of your municipality
Apply via Meu INSS (site/app), Central 135 or at an INSS agency
For persons with disabilities: attend medical and biopsychosocial assessment at INSS
Receive monthly payment through the bank indicated by INSS

eligibility.income_note: Persons aged 65+ OR persons with disability of any age (biopsychosocial assessment); per capita family income up to 1/4 of the minimum wage = R$ 405.25/month in 2026; x12 = R$ 4,863 per person per year (per-capita figure). Family must be in CadÚnico (updated within 24 months, CPF of all members), biometric registration, and reside in Brazil.

programmes.source_snippet: Possuir renda familiar per capita de até ¼ do salário mínimo; Ter idade igual ou superior a 65 anos ou deficiência verificada por meio de avaliação biopsicossocial; ... Residir no Brasil.

programmes.name_en: Inclusion Allowance for persons with disabilities entering formal work
programmes.funder: INSS (benefício assistencial, Lei nº 13.146/2015, regulamentado pelo Decreto nº 10.919/2021)
programmes.amount_note: 50% of the national minimum wage per month (R$ 810,50 in 2026) while the person works formally with pay up to 2 minimum wages.
programmes.deadline_note: BPC can be reinstated if the job ends, without a new full process.

procedure_steps.detail: Be a current or recent (last 5 years) BPC recipient with moderate or severe disability
Start formal employment with remuneration up to 2 minimum wages; BPC is suspended
Request Auxílio-Inclusão via Meu INSS, Central 135 or INSS agency

eligibility.income_note: Persons with moderate/severe disability who receive or received BPC in the last 5 years; own remuneration up to 2 minimum wages per month (R$ 3,242 in 2026); family must still meet BPC criteria (per capita family income up to 1/4 minimum wage = R$ 405.25/month; x12 = R$ 4,863 per person per year).

programmes.source_snippet: O seu valor mensal é de meio salário mínimo; ... Ter remuneração mensal limitada a 2 (dois) salários mínimos; Ter o grau de deficiência moderado ou grave;

programmes.name_local: Programa Gás do Povo (ex-Auxílio Gás dos Brasileiros)
programmes.name_en: People's Gas Programme - free LPG cylinder refills for low-income families
programmes.funder: MDS / Ministério de Minas e Energia (Lei nº 15.348/2026, ex-MP 1.313/2025); operado pela Caixa e Dataprev
programmes.amount_note: Free 13 kg LPG cylinder refills: up to 4 per year for families of 2-3 persons (one every 3 months) and up to 6 per year for families of 4+ persons. Replaces the old Auxílio Gás cash payment (about R$ 102-110 bimonthly), being phased out by 2027.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic monthly selection from CadÚnico subject to budget availability; no application needed.

procedure_steps.detail: Register and keep CadÚnico updated (data updated within the last 24 months) at the CRAS
MDS selects families automatically; check the Gás do Povo app or Caixa Tem
Redeem the free refill at a credentialed reseller using the Bolsa Família card, Caixa debit card or CPF + SMS code

documents_required.doc: CPF of the family representative regularised

eligibility.income_note: Per capita family income up to half the minimum wage (R$ 810,50/month in 2026) = R$ 9,726 per person per year (per-capita figure); family in CadÚnico, Bolsa Família families have priority. 2-3 person families get 1 voucher every 3 months; 4+ every 2 months.

programmes.source_snippet: ter renda familiar de até meio salário mínimo por pessoa. ... famílias com 2 ou 3 pessoas: recebem 1 vale a cada 3 meses. famílias com 4 ou mais pessoas: recebem 1 vale a cada 2 meses.

programmes.name_en: Occasional Benefits - one-off municipal social assistance grants (birth, death, calamity, temporary vulnerability)
programmes.funder: Municípios (fundos municipais de assistência social), no âmbito do SUAS/MDS
programmes.amount_note: Amount set by each municipality; modalities include birth benefit (auxílio-natalidade), death benefit (auxílio-funeral) and aid in situations of calamity or temporary vulnerability.
programmes.deadline_note: Requested at the CRAS/CREAS of the municipality of residence.

procedure_steps.detail: Go to the CRAS of your municipality and request the occasional benefit
Social service evaluates the situation of vulnerability
Payment made according to municipal rules (cash, voucher or in-kind)

documents_required.doc: Proof of the situation (birth/death certificate, calamity report)

eligibility.income_note: Families in situation of poverty or temporary vulnerability; criteria defined by each municipality under LOAS

programmes.source_snippet: Os benefícios eventuais são garantias previstas na Lei Orgânica da Assistência Social (Lei nº 8.742/1993) para suprir necessidades transitórias de vulnerabilidade, como nascimento, morte e calamidades.

programmes.name_en: Family Salary - INSS per-child supplement for low-wage workers
programmes.funder: INSS (pago pelo empregador e descontado da GPS)
programmes.amount_note: R$ 67,54 per month per child under 14 or disabled child of any age (2026 value, Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF nº 13 of 9 Jan 2026).
programmes.deadline_note: Paid monthly with the salary; suspended when the child turns 14 or employment ends.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the request to your employer with the children's documents
Domestic workers, unemployed and individual contributors request directly at INSS (Meu INSS/135)
Present annually proof of school attendance (from age 6) and vaccination (up to age 6)

eligibility.income_note: Worker's monthly remuneration up to R$ 1.980,38 from 01/01/2026 (individual pay, not household income); x12 = R$ 23,764.56. Employees (including domestic), avulsos, and retirees aged 65+ (men) / 60+ (women) with qualifying children.

programmes.source_snippet: A partir de 01/01/2026 | Até 1.980,38 cota 67,54 | PORTARIA INTERMINISTERIAL MPS/MF Nº 13, DE 9 DE JANEIRO DE 2026

programmes.name_en: Survivor's Pension (INSS)
programmes.funder: INSS (Regime Geral de Previdência Social)
programmes.amount_note: Family share: 50% of the deceased's retirement/benefit value + 10% per dependent (up to 100%); minimum of one minimum wage (R$ 1.621 in 2026).

procedure_steps.detail: Request via Meu INSS (site/app) or Central 135
INSS analyses dependency and the deceased's insured status
Payment to dependents in the legal order (spouse/partner, children, parents, siblings)

documents_required.doc: CPF and identity of the dependent

eligibility.income_note: No income test. The INSS pensão por morte page publishes no income ceiling for dependants or the household — requirements are that the deceased was an insured person and that dependant status is proven. 2026.

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício previdenciário pago aos dependentes do segurado da Previdência Social que falecer, conforme Lei nº 8.213/1991.

programmes.name_en: Maternity Pay (INSS), including unemployed and individual contributors
programmes.funder: INSS (para empregadas, pago pelo empregador; demais seguradas, pago diretamente pelo INSS)
programmes.amount_note: 120 days of the full salary for employees; for unemployed, individual, optional and special insureds, 1/12 of the average of last contributions, minimum one minimum wage (R$ 1.621 in 2026).
programmes.deadline_note: Request between the birth/adoption and the child's 5th birthday; unemployed insureds must request via Meu INSS.

procedure_steps.detail: Employees: inform the employer from the 28th week of pregnancy or at birth
Unemployed/individual contributors: request via Meu INSS or Central 135 after birth
INSS pays 120 days (up to 180 for employers in Empresa Cidadã)

documents_required.doc: CPF and identity of the mother

eligibility.income_note: Insured women (employed, domestic, MEI, individual, optional, unemployed within the grace period); also adoption and legal custody (to one adopter per process); no carência (minimum contribution period) for any category, but insured status must be proven (per INSS, following STF ADIs 2.110 and 2.111 / IN 188/2025).

programmes.source_snippet: Carência: Isenta para todas as categorias, devendo, entretanto, ser comprovada a qualidade de segurado. ... 120 dias no caso de parto;

programmes.name_en: Temporary Incapacity Benefit (former sickness benefit)
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: 91% of the 'salário de benefício', limited to the average of the insured's contribution salaries; minimum of one minimum wage (R$ 1.621 in 2026).
programmes.deadline_note: Requires INSS medical assessment (perícia, or online ATESTMED document analysis, which grants at most 90 days before extension); carência of 12 monthly contributions, waived for accidents, occupational disease and a list of serious illnesses.

procedure_steps.detail: Schedule medical expertise via Meu INSS or Central 135
Attend the perícia with medical documents proving the incapacity
If granted, receive monthly while the temporary incapacity lasts

documents_required.doc: Medical reports and exams proving incapacity

eligibility.income_note: INSS insured temporarily unable to work for more than 15 consecutive days; employees receive the first 15 days from the employer

programmes.source_snippet: benefício devido ao segurado do INSS que comprove, em perícia médica, estar incapacitado temporariamente para o trabalho ou sua atividade habitual por mais de 15 (quinze) dias consecutivos ... Em regra, cumprir carência de 12 contribuições mensais.

programmes.name_local: Aposentadoria por Incapacidade Permanente (ex-Aposentadoria por Invalidez)
programmes.name_en: Permanent Incapacity Retirement (former disability retirement)
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: 60% of the average contribution salary + 2% per year above 20 (men) / 15 (women) years of contribution; 100% of the average in case of work accident; minimum of one minimum wage (R$ 1.621 in 2026).
programmes.deadline_note: Requires INSS medical expertise; may add 25% if permanent assistance of a third person is needed.

procedure_steps.detail: Request via Meu INSS or Central 135
Attend medical expertise proving permanent incapacity without rehabilitation to another occupation
Receive monthly retirement; may include the 25% supplement

documents_required.doc: Medical documentation of the permanent incapacity

eligibility.income_note: INSS insured permanently unable to work and not rehabilitatable to another occupation; 12-contribution waiting period (waived for accidents/listed diseases)

programmes.source_snippet: benefício devido ao segurado permanentemente incapaz de exercer qualquer atividade laborativa e que também não possa ser reabilitado em outra profissão ... acréscimo de 25% no valor de seu benefício

programmes.name_en: Accident Aid - INSS compensation for permanent reduction of work capacity
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: 50% of the value that would be the permanent incapacity retirement; paid monthly until retirement age. Compatible with continued work.
programmes.deadline_note: Granted after consolidation of permanent sequelae from an accident; no carência required; requested by calling 135.

procedure_steps.detail: Request via Meu INSS or Central 135
Medical expertise confirms permanent sequelae that reduce work capacity
Receive monthly supplement until retirement

eligibility.income_note: Employed insureds (including domestic and special) with permanent reduction of work capacity after an accident

programmes.source_snippet: benefício de natureza indenizatória pago ao segurado do INSS quando, em decorrência de acidente, apresentar sequela permanente que reduza definitivamente sua capacidade para o trabalho ... não impede o segurado de continuar trabalhando.

programmes.name_en: Incarceration Aid - INSS benefit for dependents of low-income prisoners
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: Value proportional to the prisoner's contribution salary, minimum one minimum wage (R$ 1.621 in 2026); paid to dependents while the insured remains in closed-regime custody. Requires 24 contributions before imprisonment.
programmes.deadline_note: Only for closed-regime imprisonment of a low-income insured; ceases with release or regime progression.

procedure_steps.detail: Dependents request via Meu INSS or Central 135
Prove the insured status and low-income condition of the prisoner
Receive monthly while closed-regime custody lasts; inform any change

documents_required.doc: Proof of low income of the insured at the time of incarceration

eligibility.income_note: INSS publishes a valor limite of R$1,980.38 per month from 01/01/2026 (Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF n.º 13): the imprisoned insured's average contribution salary must not exceed it. R$1,980.38 x 12 = R$23,764.56/year. This is the insured person's own contribution wage, not total household income.

programmes.source_snippet: A média dos salários de contribuição ... deverá ser igual ou menor do que aquele informado na tabela: A partir de 01/01/2026 | 1.980,38 | PORTARIA INTERMINISTERIAL MPS/MF Nº 13

programmes.name_en: Unemployment Insurance
programmes.funder: Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (Fundo de Amparo ao Trabalhador - FAT); pago pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: 3 to 5 monthly instalments depending on time worked; minimum one minimum wage (R$ 1.621 in 2026) and maximum R$ 2.518,65 (table in force from 11 Jan 2026, for average salary above R$ 3.703,99). Fishermen, domestic workers and rescued workers have specific rules.
programmes.deadline_note: Request from the 7th to the 120th day after dismissal (employed workers).

procedure_steps.detail: Request via the Carteira de Trabalho Digital app, gov.br portal or Agências do Trabalho
Present the requerimento/CD form given by the employer
Receive 3 to 5 instalments via Caixa (Caixa Tem, branches or account credit)

documents_required.doc: Requerimento do Seguro-Desemprego (form CD) delivered by employer

eligibility.income_note: Formal workers dismissed without just cause; first request requires at least 12 months of work in the last 18 months; no other income for own subsistence

programmes.source_snippet: Ao solicitar o benefício pela primeira vez: O trabalhador deverá ter recebido pelo menos 12 salários nos últimos 18 meses imediatamente anteriores à data de dispensa.

programmes.name_en: Annual salary bonus PIS/PASEP
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (FAT); PIS pago pela Caixa, PASEP pelo Banco do Brasil
programmes.amount_note: Up to one minimum wage per year, proportional to months worked in the base year (1/12 per month); 2026 payment values from R$ 136 (1 month) to R$ 1.621 (12 months), base year 2024.
programmes.deadline_note: 2026 calendar (base year 2024): payment from 16 Feb to 17 Aug 2026 by birth month; amounts remain available until 30/12/2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility in the Carteira de Trabalho Digital app or gov.br portal
Private-sector workers receive at Caixa (Caixa Tem); public servants at Banco do Brasil
Withdraw within the calendar year

documents_required.doc: Registration in PIS/PASEP for at least 5 years

eligibility.income_note: Worked at least 30 days with formal contract in the base year with average monthly pay up to R$ 2.766 (individual remuneration, base year 2024, for the 2026 calendar); x12 = R$ 33,192; registered in PIS/PASEP for 5+ years; employer data reported in eSocial.

programmes.source_snippet: No calendário de pagamento de 2026 terão direito os trabalhadores que receberam, no ano-base 2024, remuneração média de até R$ 2.766,00 ... O Salário-Mínimo no ano de 2026 é de R$ 1.621,00

programmes.name_local: FGTS - Modalidades de Saque (Saque-Aniversário, Rescisão, Calamidade)
programmes.name_en: FGTS withdrawal modalities (anniversary withdrawal, dismissal, calamity)
programmes.funder: Caixa Econômica Federal (agente operador do FGTS)
programmes.amount_note: Saque-rescisão: full balance on dismissal without just cause (+40% fine paid by employer). Saque-aniversário: annual withdrawal of a percentage (5% to 50%) of the balance in the birthday month. Saque calamidade: up to R$ 6.220 per account in municipalities with recognised state of calamity (up to 3 withdrawals per year).
programmes.deadline_note: Saque-aniversário option made in the FGTS app; returning to saque-rescisão has a 24-month grace period.

procedure_steps.detail: Install the FGTS app and check your balance
Choose the withdrawal modality (saque-aniversário or keep saque-rescisão)
For calamity: request in the app when the municipality decree is recognised by Caixa

documents_required.doc: For calamity: declaration of residence in the affected municipality

eligibility.income_note: Workers with FGTS accounts (active or inactive); specific rules per modality

programmes.source_snippet: Saque-Rescisão – ... o trabalhador, quando demitido sem justa causa, tem direito ao saque integral da conta do FGTS, incluindo a multa rescisória ... Saque-Aniversário – sistemática opcional em que o trabalhador pode sacar anualmente, no mês de aniversário, parte do seu saldo

programmes.name_en: Closed-season insurance for artisanal fishers
programmes.funder: INSS / Ministério da Pesca e Aquicultura
programmes.amount_note: One minimum wage per month (R$ 1.621 in 2026) during the defeso (closed fishing season), usually 3-4 instalments per year.
programmes.deadline_note: Request between 30 days before the start of the closed season and the last day of the closed season, online via Meu INSS; requires RGP registration for at least 1 year, proof of social-security contribution on sales in the previous 12 months, and no other income or benefit (except auxílio-acidente and a pensão por morte up to one minimum wage).

procedure_steps.detail: Be registered as artisanal fisher (RGP) with the Ministério da Pesca
Prove artisanal fishing activity and no other remunerated activity
Request via Meu INSS/135 during the defeso period

documents_required.doc: Proof of fishing activity (colônia registration, sales notes)

eligibility.income_note: Artisanal fishers working individually or in family economy regime, without other remunerated activity or benefit

programmes.source_snippet: esteja inscrita no Registro Geral de Pesca (RGP) há pelo menos 1 ano; ... peça o benefício dentro do prazo (entre 30 dias antes da data de início do defeso até o último dia do período de defeso).

programmes.name_en: Athlete Grant Programme for high-performance athletes
programmes.funder: Ministério do Esporte; Caixa como agente pagador
programmes.amount_note: Monthly values by category (2024/2025): Base and Estudantil R$ 410; Nacional R$ 1.025; Internacional R$ 2.051; Olímpico/Paralímpico/Surdolímpico R$ 3.437; Pódio up to R$ 16.629. Paid for 12 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual application window via Sistema Bolsa Atleta (usually Jan-Feb); results published in lists.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply in the annual window at the Sistema Bolsa Atleta with gov.br login
Submit results from the previous year recognised by the Ministry
If selected, sign the term of adhesion within 30 days and receive 12 monthly instalments

documents_required.doc: Proof of sports results (official competition placements)

eligibility.income_note: Athletes in Olympic, Paralympic, Deaflympic and recognised non-Olympic modalities with results in the previous year; no income test (programme for athletes without sponsorship)

programmes.source_snippet: O valor da Bolsa Atleta varia de R$ 410,00 até R$ 16.629,00, conforme categoria do atleta... O pagamento é realizado pelo período de 12 meses.

programmes.name_en: Training Grant for workers in professional qualification courses
programmes.funder: Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (FAT)
programmes.amount_note: Free professional qualification courses (Pronatec Bolsa-Formação Trabalhador) for workers, including those receiving unemployment insurance; students receive meals, transport and school materials. No separate cash grant of one minimum wage per month is stated by the official sources.
programmes.deadline_note: Unemployment insurance payment is conditioned on enrolment and attendance in a qualification course; courses offered via Agências do Trabalho/SINE and the Pronatec network.

procedure_steps.detail: When applying for unemployment insurance, manifest interest in a qualification course
Enrol in a course of the Plano de Qualificação (Pronatec/Rede Federal or contracted institutions)
Receive one minimum wage monthly for the duration of the course

eligibility.income_note: Workers entitled to unemployment insurance who enrol in professional qualification courses

programmes.source_snippet: O recebimento da assistência financeira do Programa Seguro-Desemprego fica condicionado à comprovação de matrícula e de frequência do trabalhador em curso de formação inicial e continuada ou qualificação profissional.

programmes.name_en: Social Electricity Tariff - discounts on power bills for low-income families
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Lei nº 12.212/2010, alterada pela Lei nº 15.235/2025); regulada pela ANEEL e aplicada pelas distribuidoras
programmes.amount_note: Since bills issued from 5 July 2025 there is a single discount band: 100% off for consumption up to 80 kWh per month (eligible families pay nothing for the first 80 kWh); consumption above 80 kWh gets no discount. This replaced the earlier progressive bands (65% / 40% / 10%). Free of the CDE and Proinfa charges.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically to the electricity bill after CadÚnico/INSS data cross-check; if not applied, request at the distributor with the NIS number.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in CadÚnico (CRAS) or be a BPC beneficiary
Discount is applied automatically to the bill of the residence
If not applied, contact the power distributor with the NIS/Benefit number

documents_required.doc: CadÚnico registration (NIS) or BPC benefit number
CPF of the electricity bill holder

eligibility.income_note: ANEEL: families in CadÚnico with monthly per-capita household income of at most half the national minimum wage. 2026 minimum wage = R$1,621.00, so half = R$810.50/month per person; x12 = R$9,726/year per person. A separate route covers CadÚnico families up to 3 minimum wages/month where a member depends on continuous electrically powered medical equipment.

programmes.source_snippet: Passa a existir apenas uma faixa de desconto para os beneficiários da Tarifa Social: 100% para o consumo até 80 kWh mensais. A parcela de consumo que ultrapassar 80 kWh não receberá desconto.

programmes.name_en: My Home My Life - Band 1 subsidised housing for lowest-income families
programmes.funder: Ministério das Cidades; operado pela Caixa (recursos FGTS e Orçamento da União)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised housing units for Faixa 1 (gross family income up to R$ 3.200 urban; up to R$ 50.000 per year rural). Families receiving BPC or Bolsa Família are exempt from instalments (unit 100% free). CAIXA's MCMV Cidades page lists a maximum aporte of R$ 55 mil; the gov.br/cidades page does not state a subsidy amount.
programmes.deadline_note: Selection done by municipalities/states (social selection) or directly at developers for subsidised units.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in the municipal housing secretariat selection (CadÚnico-based) or look for MCMV Faixa 1 developments
Be indicated by the public entity or approved by Caixa credit analysis
Sign the subsidised financing contract at Caixa

documents_required.doc: CPF and identity documents of the family

eligibility.income_note: Gross monthly family income up to R$ 3.200 in urban areas (x12 = R$ 38,400 per household per year) or up to R$ 50.000 per year in rural areas (Portaria MCID nº 333 of 30 Mar 2026); priority to women-headed households, persons with disabilities, elderly, families in vulnerable situations.

programmes.source_snippet: As famílias da chamada Faixa 1 com renda mensal bruta limitada a R$ 3.200 (três mil e duzentos reais) em áreas urbanas, é de R$ 50.000,00 (cinquenta mil reais) anuais, nas áreas rurais

programmes.name_local: Minha Casa, Minha Vida - Faixas 2 e 3 (Urbano)
programmes.name_en: My Home My Life - Bands 2 and 3 subsidised housing finance
programmes.funder: Ministério das Cidades; operado pela Caixa (FGTS)
programmes.amount_note: Faixa 2 (family income R$ 3.200,01 to R$ 5.000) and Faixa 3 (R$ 5.000,01 to R$ 9.600): FGTS-funded financing at reduced interest; Faixa 3 interest 7,66% to 8,16% a.a.; Faixa 2 can receive FGTS subsidy depending on income; Faixa 3 can buy properties up to R$ 400 mil. Faixa 4 (Classe Média) up to R$ 13.000 at 10% a.a. Subsidy caps in the earlier record (R$ 35 mil / R$ 20 mil) come from an older CAIXA page and are not confirmed by the current gov.br page.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply directly at Caixa or at developers of MCMV projects; credit analysis required.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose an MCMV development and check the income band
Do a housing credit simulation and analysis at Caixa
Sign the subsidised FGTS financing contract

documents_required.doc: Proof of income (payslips, bank statements for self-employed)
Property documents of the chosen unit

eligibility.income_note: Gross monthly family income from R$ 3.200,01 up to R$ 9.600 for Faixas 2-3 (x12 = R$ 115,200 per household per year at the upper limit); Classe Média up to R$ 13.000 handled separately; rural annual limits R$ 50.000,01 to R$ 134.000. Cannot own another residential property in the same municipality.

programmes.source_snippet: Faixa 2 | até R$ 3.200,01 a R$ 5.000,00 ... Faixa 3 | de até R$ 5.000,01 a R$ 9.600,00 ... Faixa 4 (Classe Média) | Até R$ 13.000,00

programmes.name_en: My Home My Life Rural - housing subsidy for rural families
programmes.funder: Ministério das Cidades; operado pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy for rural housing for families with gross annual income up to R$ 50.000 (Faixa Rural 1): production of a housing unit up to R$ 97.500 (up to R$ 107.000 in the North region); improvement of a unit up to R$ 50.000 (up to R$ 55.000 in the North region); includes cistern and effluent treatment. Proposals are submitted by municipalities, states or non-profit entities.
programmes.deadline_note: Families are organised and indicated by the executing public entity (state/municipality) or rural unions.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the municipal housing/rural development secretariat
Entity submits the project to Caixa/Ministério das Cidades
Approved families receive the subsidy for construction or renovation

documents_required.doc: Proof of rural activity (DAP, CAR or union declaration)
Proof of land ownership or authorised possession

eligibility.income_note: Rural families with gross annual income up to R$ 50.000 working in family agriculture, forestry, aquaculture, extractivism, fishing, indigenous and quilombola communities, or other rural residents.

programmes.name_en: Pé-de-Meia student savings incentive for low-income public high school students
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (MEC); contas abertas automaticamente pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: Incentivo Frequência: up to R$ 1.800 per year, paid in up to 9 monthly instalments of R$ 200 for regular high school (80% attendance), or up to 8 instalments of R$ 225 for EJA. Plus Incentivo Matrícula, Incentivo Conclusão (savings released after graduation) and Incentivo Enem as recorded.

Track balances in the Pé-de-Meia/Caixa Tem app; savings released after high school completion

documents_required.doc: Enrolment in a public high school or EJA

eligibility.income_note: Students aged 14-24 with regularised CPF in public high school (regular or EJA), belonging to families registered in CadÚnico with per capita income up to half the minimum wage (R$ 810,50/month in 2026; x12 = R$ 9,726 per person per year, per-capita figure).

programmes.source_snippet: Até R$ 1.800 ao ano, divididos em até 9 parcelas mensais de R$ 200,00, caso atinja frequência mínima de 80% no mês ou no período.

programmes.name_local: Fundo de Financiamento Estudantil (Fies / Novo Fies / Fies Social)
programmes.name_en: Student Financing Fund (Fies) - government-backed tuition financing
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (FNDE); Caixa como agente operador
programmes.amount_note: Zero interest rate for all students; you study first and start paying after graduation; no guarantor needed if family income is up to 1.5 minimum wage per person. If pre-selected, deliver documents at the higher education institution within the deadline
Sign the contract at Caixa and renew each semester

Income documents of the family group
RG, CPF and proof of residence of student and family members

eligibility.income_note: Family income up to 3 minimum wages per person (R$ 4.863/month in 2026; x12 = R$ 58,356 per person per year, per-capita figure); no guarantor required up to 1.5 minimum wage per person. Enem from 2010 with average score at least 450 and essay above zero.

programmes.source_snippet: Taxa de juros ZERO para todos os estudantes; Sem necessidade de fiador se sua renda familiar for até 1,5 salário mínimo por pessoa. ... Renda familiar até 3 salários mínimos por pessoa;

programmes.name_en: University for All - full and partial scholarships at private universities
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (MEC)
programmes.amount_note: Full scholarships (100%) for per capita family income up to 1.5 minimum wage; partial scholarships (50%) for income up to 3 minimum wages; Enem average of at least 450 points and essay above zero, in one of the last two editions before the selection.
programmes.deadline_note: Two selection processes per year (1st and 2nd semester), using Enem scores.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the ProUni portal during the semiannual window with gov.br login
If pre-selected, deliver income and schooling documents at the institution
Enrol with the full or partial scholarship

documents_required.doc: Enem result (450+ average, essay above zero)
Proof of public high school or full private-school scholarship

eligibility.income_note: Bolsa integral: family income up to 1.5 minimum wage per person (R$ 2.431,50/month in 2026); bolsa parcial: up to 3 minimum wages per person (R$ 4.863/month; x12 = R$ 58,356 per person per year, per-capita figure); Brazilian students without a higher-education degree; high school completed in public school or as full scholarship holder (other cases for partial scholarship); persons with disability and public-school teachers (licenciatura/pedagogia, no income test) have separate rules.

programmes.source_snippet: Bolsa integral (100%): Renda familiar menor ou igual a 1,5 salário-mínimo por pessoa; Bolsa parcial (50%): Renda familiar menor ou igual a 3 salários-mínimos por pessoa. ... Estudantes brasileiros sem diploma de curso superior

programmes.name_local: Isenção da Taxa de Inscrição do Enem
programmes.name_en: Enem registration fee waiver
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação / Inep
programmes.amount_note: Full waiver of the Enem registration fee (R$ 85,00) for: students in the last year of public high school; people who completed high school in public school or as full scholarship holders with per-person family income up to 1.5 minimum wage; and CadÚnico families with per-person income up to half a minimum wage or total monthly family income up to 3 minimum wages.
programmes.deadline_note: Waiver request window opens before Enem registration each year (usually April); unjustified absence in the previous edition blocks a new waiver.

procedure_steps.detail: Request the waiver at the Página do Participante during the waiver window
Inep cross-checks CadÚnico/public school data
If denied, file an appeal within the deadline or pay the fee

documents_required.doc: CPF and personal data matching Receita Federal records
CadÚnico registration or proof of public high school enrolment

eligibility.income_note: Three routes: (1) last year of public high school, no income test; (2) all high school in public school/full scholarship with income up to 1.5 minimum wage per person; (3) CadÚnico with valid NIS and income up to half a minimum wage per person or up to 3 minimum wages total monthly family income (R$ 4.863/month; x12 = R$ 58,356 per household).

programmes.source_snippet: Tem direito a não pagar a taxa de inscrição quem: está cursando a última série do ensino médio, no ano da edição, em escola da rede pública; cursou todo o ensino médio em escola da rede pública ou como bolsista integral na rede privada; além de ter renda, por pessoa, igual ou menor que um salário mínimo e meio

programmes.name_local: Política Nacional de Assistência Estudantil (PNAES) - Auxílios Permanência
programmes.name_en: National Student Assistance Policy - housing, food and transport grants at federal universities/institutes
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação; executada pelas IFES (universidades e institutos federais)
programmes.amount_note: Direct benefits (housing, food, transport, health, digital inclusion, culture, sport, childcare, pedagogic support) set by each federal institution's own assistance programme; the Bolsa Permanência is a cash grant; total pecuniary student-assistance benefits per student may not exceed 1.5 minimum wages (R$ 2.431,50 in 2026), except for indigenous and quilombola students.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at the student assistance sector (pró-reitoria de assuntos estudantis) of your federal university/institute; socioeconomic evaluation required.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol at a federal university or instituto federal
Apply for student assistance at the institution's PRAE and submit to socioeconomic evaluation
If selected, receive monthly auxílio or in-kind support (housing, meals, transport)

documents_required.doc: Proof of enrolment at the IFES
Proof of residence and housing costs

eligibility.income_note: Lei n.º 14.914/2024 (PNAES): the Bolsa Permanência requires monthly per-capita household income not above 1 minimum wage, and the Programa de Assistência Estudantil uses gross monthly per-capita income up to 1 minimum wage with a priority band at up to half. 2026 minimum wage R$1,621.00 x 12 = R$19,452/year per person (priority band R$9,726/yr).

programmes.source_snippet: IV - ser integrante de grupo familiar em situação de vulnerabilidade socioeconômica, observado o limite de renda bruta familiar mensal per capita de até 1 (um) salário mínimo ... IX - ser estudante estrangeiro em situação de vulnerabilidade socioeconômica ou refugiado.

programmes.name_local: Lei de Cotas (Lei nº 12.711/2012) - Reserva de Vagas nas Universidades Federais
programmes.name_en: Quota Law - reserved places at federal universities and institutes for public-school students
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (aplicada pelas IFES via Sisu e vestibulares próprios)
programmes.amount_note: At least 50% of places in each course at federal universities and institutos federais reserved for students who completed all of high school in public schools; half of those places go to students with family income up to 1 minimum wage per capita (lowered from 1.5 by Lei 14.723/2023), with sub-quotas for pretos, pardos, indígenas, quilombolas and persons with disability.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically at enrolment in Sisu or the institution's own selection; annual windows.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Sisu or the federal institution's vestibular choosing the quota modality
If approved, present proof of public high school completion (and income/race declaration where applicable)
Enrol in the reserved place

documents_required.doc: Full high school transcript from public schools

eligibility.income_note: Lei n.º 12.711/2012 as amended by Lei n.º 14.723/2023: half of the reserved places go to students from families with income at or below 1 minimum wage per capita (lowered from the original 1.5). 2026 minimum wage R$1,621.00 x 12 = R$19,452/year per person. The other half of reserved places has no income condition.

programmes.source_snippet: Redução do critério de renda familiar per capita para um salário-mínimo na reserva de vagas de 50% das cotas.

programmes.name_local: Gratuidade no Transporte Coletivo para Idosos (65+)
programmes.name_en: Free public transport for seniors aged 65+ (Estatuto do Idoso)
programmes.funder: Poder público municipal/estadual e empresas concessionárias (Lei nº 10.741/2003, art. 39)
programmes.amount_note: Free urban public transport (buses, and in most cities metro/trains) for persons aged 65 or over, upon presentation of an identity document; some municipalities extend to 60+ (e.g. São Paulo city, Rio de Janeiro).
programmes.deadline_note: Issue the senior/free-fare card at the municipal transport authority or just present ID where accepted.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the rule of your municipality (65+ nationally; some cities 60+)
Issue the free-fare card (e.g. Bilhete Único Idoso, Riocard Gratuidade) at the transport operator or just board with ID
Use public transport free of charge

documents_required.doc: Identity document with photo proving age

eligibility.income_note: All persons aged 65+ regardless of income (some municipalities grant from age 60)

programmes.source_snippet: Art. 39. É assegurada, no sistema de transporte coletivo, a gratuidade aos maiores de 65 anos... reservados 10% dos assentos, devidamente identificados.

programmes.name_local: Passe Livre Interestadual para Pessoa com Deficiência
programmes.name_en: Free interstate travel pass for persons with disabilities in economic hardship

programmes.amount_note: Full fare exemption on interstate collective road transport for persons with disability with per capita family income up to one minimum wage; companion may travel free when medically justified.
programmes.deadline_note: Credential issued digitally by ANTT after document analysis; keep CadÚnico updated.

procedure_steps.detail: Update CadÚnico and gather medical report of the disability
Apply at the ANTT Passe Livre system
After approval, present the digital credential when buying the interstate ticket

documents_required.doc: CadÚnico registration (income up to 1 minimum wage per capita)

programmes.source_snippet: O Passe Livre Interestadual é a gratuidade no transporte coletivo interestadual de passageiros concedida à pessoa com deficiência comprovadamente carente, nos termos da Lei nº 8.899, de 29 de junho de 1994. ... renda familiar per capta de até 1 salário-mínimo.

programmes.name_en: Transport Voucher - employer-funded commuting benefit with 6% payroll deduction
programmes.funder: Empregador (obrigação legal); regulado pelo Ministério do Trabalho

Employer provides tickets/credits monthly
Up to 6% of basic salary is deducted from payroll

programmes.name_local: Meia-Entrada (Estatuto da Juventude / Estatuto do Idoso / LBI)

Present the document when buying the ticket

programmes.name_en: People's Pharmacy - free and subsidised medicines

Present prescription, CPF and ID; free items are dispensed at no cost

Join the free guided activities

programmes.name_local: Programa de Proteção e Promoção da Saúde Menstrual (Dignidade Menstrual)

programmes.name_en: National Oriented Productive Microcredit Programme
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego); operado por bancos públicos (Caixa, BB, BNB, Basa) e agentes credenciados
programmes.amount_note: Microcredit up to R$ 21.000 (higher with guarantee) for working capital and investment of microentrepreneurs, with mandatory technical guidance (orientação) and subsidised rates.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at microcredit agents of public banks or accredited institutions.

procedure_steps.detail: Look for a microcredit agent (Caixa, Banco do Brasil, BNB, Banco da Amazônia or OSCIPs)
Agent visits and evaluates the business (microcrédito produtivo orientado)
Credit released with follow-up technical guidance

documents_required.doc: Proof of business activity and residence

eligibility.income_note: Entrepreneurs (individuals or companies, formal or informal) with annual turnover up to R$ 200 mil per the Ministry of Finance page; note Banco do Nordeste's Crediamigo (a PNMPO operator) publishes R$ 360 mil. Turnover, not household income.

programmes.source_snippet: As operações são direcionadas a pessoas naturais e jurídicas empreendedoras de atividades produtivas urbanas e rurais, de forma individual ou coletiva, com faturamento de até R$ 200 mil.

programmes.name_local: Programa Nacional de Fortalecimento da Agricultura Familiar (Pronaf)
programmes.name_en: Pronaf - subsidised credit for family farming
programmes.funder: Ministério do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar (MDA); operado por bancos oficiais
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised rural credit for family farmers, Safra 2026/2027 (R$ 85,2 bi planned). Limits and rates vary by line: Pronaf B investment from R$ 12 mil; Bioeconomia up to R$ 250 mil; Agroecologia up to R$ 250 mil or R$ 450 mil; interest from 0,5% to 9% a.a. depending on the line. R$ 500 mil is the family income ceiling, not a loan limit.
programmes.deadline_note: Lines follow the Plano Safra (July 2026 - June 2027); requires a valid CAF (Cadastro Nacional da Agricultura Familiar).

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain the Declaração de Aptidão ao Pronaf (DAP/CAF) at Emater, sindicato rural or Sebrae
Take the project to an official bank (BB, Caixa, BNB, cooperatives)
Sign the contract with subsidised interest and pay per harvest calendar

documents_required.doc: CPF, ID and proof of rural activity
Property or possession documents of the land

eligibility.income_note: Family gross annual income up to R$ 500 mil (100% of gross production value plus other income, excluding social benefits); lower ceilings for specific lines (Pronaf B R$ 60 mil; Mulher/Jovem lines R$ 150 mil).

programmes.source_snippet: Tenham obtido renda bruta familiar nos últimos 12 meses de produção normal que antecedem a solicitação do CAF de até R$ 500 mil

programmes.name_local: Programa Nacional de Apoio ao Médio Produtor Rural (Pronamp)
programmes.name_en: Pronamp - subsidised credit for medium rural producers
programmes.funder: Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária (MAPA); operado por bancos oficiais
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised working-capital and investment credit for medium rural producers with annual gross income up to R$ 3,5 milhões (at least 80% from farming); credit limit up to R$ 1,5 milhão per client per agricultural year across the rural credit system (BNDES). Interest follows the Plano Safra line.
programmes.deadline_note: Lines opened each Plano Safra (July-June).

procedure_steps.detail: Take the financing proposal to an official bank or cooperative
Prove medium-producer condition (annual gross revenue up to R$ 3 milhões)
Contract costeio or investment credit with subsidised interest

documents_required.doc: Proof of rural activity and revenue

eligibility.income_note: Rural owners, squatters, tenants or partners with annual gross income up to R$ 3.500.000 (sum of production value and other income) and at least 80% of it from agriculture/livestock.

programmes.source_snippet: possuam renda bruta anual de até R$ 3,5 milhões. Limite de crédito até R$ 1,5 milhão por cliente, em cada Ano Agrícola e em todo o Sistema Nacional de Crédito Rural (SNCR).

programmes.name_en: Desenrola Brasil - debt renegotiation programme with discounts
programmes.funder: Ministério da Fazenda (MP nº 1.355/2026); operado pelos bancos e pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: Renegotiation of overdue credit card, overdraft and personal-credit (CDC) debts contracted until 31/01/2026 and overdue 91 days to 2 years: discounts up to 90%, maximum interest 1,99% a month, up to 48 months, partial use of FGTS balance allowed.
programmes.deadline_note: Ended: the Renegociação de Dívidas - Famílias (Novo Desenrola Brasil, MP 1.355/2026) was available until 31 August 2026 per the official gov.br service page. Desenrola Fies is a separate track.

procedure_steps.detail: Check your overdue debts with your banks
Renegotiate through official channels: gov.br, Caixa Tem or your bank
Pay at sight (bigger discount) or in up to 48 instalments; name cleared within 5 days after first payment

documents_required.doc: Proof of income up to 5 minimum wages

eligibility.income_note: Individuals with monthly income up to 5 minimum wages (R$ 8.105/month = R$ 97.260/year) with eligible overdue debts; negotiate directly with the participating bank.

programmes.source_snippet: A Renegociação de Dívidas - Famílias permanecerá disponível até o dia 31 de agosto de 2026.

programmes.name_en: Cisterns Programme - free water tanks for semi-arid families
programmes.funder: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS); executado por entidades e estados
programmes.amount_note: Free construction of 16.000-litre plate cisterns for drinking water and cisterns for production (52.000 litres, calçadão) for low-income rural families in the Semi-arid region.
programmes.deadline_note: Families are indicated by municipal committees/executing entities from CadÚnico; no direct application.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in CadÚnico at the CRAS of your rural municipality
Municipal management committee selects beneficiary families
Executing entity builds the cistern with family participation

eligibility.income_note: Rural families in CadUnico with per-person monthly income up to half a minimum wage (R$ 810,50 = R$ 9.726/year per person); priority to traditional peoples and communities; families are indicated through the programme's executing entities.

programmes.source_snippet: Destina-se a famílias rurais de baixa renda (renda per capita de até meio salário mínimo) e a equipamentos públicos rurais afetados pela seca ou falta de água, com prioridade para povos e comunidades tradicionais.

programmes.name_local: Tarifa Social de Água e Esgoto - Sabesp (Tarifa Residencial Social e Vulnerável)
programmes.name_en: Sabesp social water and sewage tariff
programmes.funder: Sabesp (contrato de concessão com o Estado de São Paulo)
programmes.amount_note: Fixed social tariff for up to 10 m³/month: R$ 16,42 (Vulnerável, per capita income up to R$ 218) or R$ 21 (Social, income up to half minimum wage) - discounts up to about 78% versus the standard residential tariff.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic for CadUnico customers whose account holder matches the CadUnico registration; keep CadUnico updated every 2 years. Unemployed and collective housing need documents and/or inspection; no retroactive effect.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
Ensure the Sabesp bill holder's CPF matches the CadÚnico
Discount applies automatically; if not, request at Sabesp with the NIS

eligibility.income_note: Per-person monthly income up to half a minimum wage in CadUnico (R$ 810,50 = R$ 9.726/year per person) for the Social tariff; Vulnerável tariff up to R$ 218 per person. Also available to unemployed people (last salary up to 3 minimum wages, consumption up to 15 m³, 90 days account holder) and families receiving BPC.

programmes.source_snippet: Tarifa Residencial Social para Pessoas inscritas no CadÚnico: Estar cadastrado no CadÚnico com renda mensal por pessoa de até meio salário mínimo;

programmes.name_local: Tarifa Social de Água - Copasa (Minas Gerais)
programmes.name_en: Copasa social water tariff (Minas Gerais)
programmes.funder: Copasa (Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais) / Estado de Minas Gerais
programmes.amount_note: Social tariff with a discount of up to 50% on the water and sewage bill for CadUnico families in municipalities served by Copasa.
programmes.deadline_note: Not automatic: request at www.copasa.com.br or by WhatsApp (31) 9 9770-7000 (Mon-Fri 8h-18h) with ID, CPF, a recent water bill and proof of CadUnico registration.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
Request the social tariff at Copasa (agency, site or call center) with the NIS
Discount applied to the monthly bill

eligibility.income_note: Low-income families in CadÚnico served by Copasa; per capita income limits defined in the concession contract

programmes.source_snippet: Para solicitar, o cliente precisa apresentar: ● Documento de identidade e CPF; ● Conta de água da residência; ● Comprovante de Cadastro no CadÚnico.

programmes.name_local: Programa Casa Paulista - CDHU (Habitação Social do Estado de São Paulo)
programmes.name_en: Casa Paulista / CDHU state social housing programme (São Paulo)
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado de São Paulo - Companhia de Desenvolvimento Habitacional e Urbano (CDHU)
programmes.amount_note: Casa Paulista - Carta de Crédito Imobiliário: state credit letter of R$ 10 mil to R$ 16 mil for families earning 1 to 3 minimum wages buying a home directly from a developer, financed by Caixa; the programme also offers subsidy certificates for families with gross monthly income up to R$ 4.863,00.
programmes.deadline_note: No registration or lottery: check household income (max 3 minimum wages), choose a property from the monthly list of active developments, visit it and simulate financing with Caixa on site; credit approval is Caixa's.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in the municipal housing list (secretaria municipal de habitação)
CDHU and municipality select families by criteria (income, time in municipality, vulnerability)
Receive the housing unit or Cheque-Moradia subsidy

documents_required.doc: CPF, ID and documents of the family

eligibility.income_note: Household income up to 3 minimum wages (R$ 4.863/month = R$ 58.356/year); subsidy certificates cap at R$ 4.863 gross monthly income.

programmes.source_snippet: Famílias que ganham de 1 a 3 salários mínimos mensais podem comprar a sua casa ou apartamento diretamente com a construtora, sem a necessidade de sorteio, utilizando uma carta de crédito com valores de R$ 10 mil (dez mil) a R$ 16 mil (dezesseis mil)

programmes.name_local: CNH Social / Habilitação Social (Programas Estaduais de CNH Gratuita)
programmes.name_en: Social Driver's Licence - free first driving licence programmes in several states
programmes.funder: Governos estaduais e Detrans (federal legal basis: Lei nº 15.153/2025; ex.: CNH da Gente/BA, Habilitação Social/DF, CNH Social/GO, MA, PE)
programmes.amount_note: All stages of the first driver's licence free (medical and psychological exams, theoretical and practical classes and tests, licence issuance) - savings of roughly R$ 1.500 to R$ 3.000 depending on the state.
programmes.deadline_note: State editais with limited places, usually once a year per state; check the Detran site of your state.

procedure_steps.detail: Keep CadÚnico updated and watch the Detran/state government edital
Apply online in the edital window with CPF
If selected, complete all licensing steps free of charge within 12 months

documents_required.doc: CPF and ID (18 years or older)
Proof of residence in the state

eligibility.income_note: Low-income persons (CadÚnico, per capita income typically up to half minimum wage) in states running the programme; priority rules vary (students, women, programme beneficiaries)

programmes.source_snippet: A Lei nº 15.153/2025, que alterou o Código de Trânsito Brasileiro (CTB), passou a prever que órgãos de trânsito estaduais e do Distrito Federal utilizem recursos arrecadados com multas para custear a formação de condutores de baixa renda, por meio do programa CNH Social.

programmes.name_local: Bilhete Único Estudante - Gratuidade no Transporte Escolar (São Paulo/SP)
programmes.name_en: Free student transit pass in the city of São Paulo
programmes.funder: Prefeitura de São Paulo / SPTrans
programmes.amount_note: Bilhete Único de Estudante gives free travel (gratuidade) or half fare (meia tarifa) on São Paulo city transit. Gratuidade: students of the city with a valid CadUnico NIS (per-person family income up to 1.5 minimum wages), ProUni/FIES students, and some profiles automatically without income proof (see SPTrans questionnaire); others get half fare. The student pays an annual amount ('valor correspondente') to activate the benefit.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual: revalidate the previous-year card (sticker) or order a new card; the benefit is issued via the SPTrans student portal/educational institution.

procedure_steps.detail: Request the Bilhete Único Estudante through your school (secretaria escolar)
SPTrans issues the card; student activates and uses it
Revalidate annually via the school

documents_required.doc: Proof of enrolment (provided by the school)
CPF and ID of the student
Proof of residence in São Paulo

eligibility.income_note: Per-person family income up to 1.5 minimum wages (about R$ 2.431,50/month) via CadUnico for the income-based gratuidade route; automatic and ProUni/FIES routes have no income test, so no household ceiling is set.

programmes.source_snippet: Você possui um NIS (Número de Identificação Social) válido, registrado no CadÚnico, comprovando uma renda familiar mensal per capita de até 1,5 salário mínimo?

programmes.name_local: Passe Livre Estudantil - Rio de Janeiro (Riocard)
programmes.name_en: Free student pass in the city of Rio de Janeiro
programmes.funder: Prefeitura do Rio de Janeiro / Fetranspor (Riocard)
programmes.amount_note: Free public transport for students of the municipal and state public school networks in Rio city (Passe Livre usable on weekends and holidays, 76 trips per month). Passe Livre Universitário (Lei 6.833/2020) covers quota students, ProUni students and students with family per-capita income up to one minimum wage.
programmes.deadline_note: Requested at the beginning of the school year via the school or the Riocard Mais app; annual revalidation.

procedure_steps.detail: Request the Vale-Estudante via your school or the Riocard Mais app
Card issued and delivered (school or Riocard posts)
Use municipal buses free; revalidate annually

documents_required.doc: CPF and ID of the student

eligibility.income_note: No income test for public-school students; university route requires quota/ProUni status or per-capita family income up to 1 minimum wage (about R$ 1.621/month), so no single ceiling is set.

programmes.source_snippet: A Cidade do Rio de Janeiro garante gratuidade no transporte público para estudantes das redes públicas do Município e do Estado do Rio.

programmes.name_en: Family Carioca Card - municipal income complement of Rio de Janeiro city
programmes.funder: Prefeitura do Rio de Janeiro - Secretaria Municipal de Assistência Social (SMAS)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly municipal cash transfer complementing Bolsa Família for low-income families of the city registered in CadÚnico, prioritising those with children and in extreme poverty; values and rules set by municipal decree (paid on the Cartão Família Carioca).
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic selection from CadÚnico by the municipal social assistance secretariat; keep registration updated at the CRAS.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS of Rio de Janeiro
SMAS selects eligible families automatically
Receive monthly on the Cartão Família Carioca

eligibility.income_note: Low-income families of the municipality of Rio de Janeiro in CadÚnico, prioritising extreme poverty and families with children

programmes.source_snippet: O Cartão Família Carioca é o programa municipal de transferência de renda da Prefeitura do Rio voltado a famílias em situação de vulnerabilidade inscritas no CadÚnico.

programmes.name_en: SuperaRJ - state income transfer of Rio de Janeiro
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro - Secretaria de Assistência Social e Direitos Humanos
programmes.amount_note: Per the official FAQ (2021 emergency programme): R$ 200 plus R$ 80 gas aid plus R$ 50 per child under 18 (max 2 children), up to R$ 380 per month.
programmes.deadline_note: Ended: the official FAQ describes a COVID-19 emergency minimum-income programme with payments from June 2021 and a forecast end in December 2021; no current enrolment is published and it did not complement Bolsa Família (recipients of federal transfer programmes were excluded).

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS of your municipality
State selects families automatically by poverty criteria
Receive monthly on the programme's card

eligibility.income_note: 2021 rules: CadUnico per-person income up to R$ 210/month (R$ 2.520/year), or formal workers dismissed during the pandemic with last salary below R$ 1.501; not for recipients of federal transfer programmes.

programmes.source_snippet: O Supera RJ é um programa de renda mínima que tem como objetivo o enfrentamento e a superação da crise econômica causada pelas medidas de combate ao novo Corona vírus (COVID - 19)

programmes.name_en: Bolsa do Povo - umbrella of state income grants of São Paulo
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado de São Paulo - Secretaria de Desenvolvimento Social (SEDS)
programmes.amount_note: State income grants under one umbrella: Bolsa Trabalho (R$ 540/month for unemployed in temporary activities), Bolsa Empreendedor, Ação Jovem, Bolsa Estudante and Renda Básica for families in extreme poverty; values per modality.
programmes.deadline_note: Registration via CRAS or the Bolsa do Povo portal, depending on the modality.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
Apply for the specific modality (Bolsa Trabalho, Ação Jovem, Renda Básica) at the CRAS or programme portal
Receive monthly while complying with the modality conditions

documents_required.doc: Proof of residence in São Paulo state

eligibility.income_note: Low-income families and unemployed persons of São Paulo state; criteria per modality (Bolsa Trabalho requires unemployment over 1 year for many profiles)

programmes.source_snippet: O Bolsa do Povo reúne os programas de transferência de renda do Estado de São Paulo, como Bolsa Trabalho, Ação Jovem, Bolsa Empreendedor e Renda Básica.

programmes.name_en: Bolsa Presença - school attendance grant of Bahia state
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado da Bahia - Secretaria da Educação (SEC)
programmes.amount_note: R$ 150 per month per family with one admitted student, plus R$ 50 per additional student from the second; paid on the 15th of the month after school activities, on a Lecard card. Requires at least 75% school attendance and other conditions.
programmes.deadline_note: Permanent programme (Lei 14.396/2021) run with the school calendar: eligible families (CadUnico + state-network enrolment) collect the card at the school and sign the Termo de Compromisso.

procedure_steps.detail: Be enrolled in the Bahia state public network
Selection by socioeconomic vulnerability (CadÚnico cross-check)
Receive the grant conditional on school attendance

documents_required.doc: Enrolment in the state public network

eligibility.income_note: Families in CadUnico in poverty/extreme poverty, per-person income of R$ 218/month (R$ 2.616/year per person), with a student enrolled in the Bahia state public network; Bolsa Família is not required.

programmes.source_snippet: Será concedida bolsa mensal à família do aluno participante do Programa Bolsa Presença nos seguintes termos: I – no valor de R$ 150,00 (cento e cinquenta reais) por família com até um aluno admitido no Programa;

programmes.name_en: More Childhood Card - Ceará state transfer for young children
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado do Ceará - Secretaria da Proteção Social (SPS)
programmes.amount_note: State cash transfer of R$ 100 per month to families with children aged 0 to 5 years and 11 months in extreme poverty (state page, from March 2021); paid per family, not per child. A municipal (Sobral) page cites R$ 150, which the state page does not confirm.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic selection from CadÚnico; conditions monitored via health/school attendance.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
State selects families with children 0-6 in extreme poverty
Receive monthly on the Cartão Mais Infância, keeping vaccination and school attendance

eligibility.income_note: Families in extreme poverty registered in CadUnico with children aged 0 to 5 years and 11 months; the income ceiling is not stated on the state page.

programmes.source_snippet: Cartão Mais Infância. – Transferência de renda mensal, no valor de R$ 100, a partir de março de 2021, para famílias com crianças de 0 a 5 anos e 11 meses em

programmes.name_en: Children's Milk Programme - free powdered milk for children of Paraná
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado do Paraná - Secretaria da Agricultura e do Abastecimento (SEAB)
programmes.amount_note: Free daily litre of pasteurised whole milk enriched with vitamins A, D and iron for children aged 6 to 36 months (not powdered milk), distributed at schools.
programmes.deadline_note: Register at the municipal CRAS or CREAS with photo ID, proof of address, proof of income and the child's birth certificate; milk starts within 30 days of document check.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the child at the UBS of your municipality
Present CadÚnico/NIS and child documents
Collect the monthly milk supply free of charge

documents_required.doc: Birth certificate and vaccination card of the child

eligibility.income_note: Per-person income up to half the Paraná regional minimum wage: R$ 2.105,34 in 2026 (Resolução SEAB 62/2026) so R$ 1.052,67/month = about R$ 12.632/year per person.

programmes.source_snippet: distribuição gratuita e diária de um litro de leite a crianças de seis a 36 meses, pertencentes a famílias cuja renda por pessoa não ultrapasse meio salário mínimo regional.

programmes.name_local: Programa Devolve ICMS (Rio Grande do Sul)
programmes.name_en: Give-Back ICMS - tax cashback for low-income families of Rio Grande do Sul
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul - Secretaria da Fazenda (SEFAZ)
programmes.amount_note: Minimum R$ 400 per year paid in four quarterly instalments of R$ 100, plus a variable part that grows with the number of receipts issued with the beneficiary's CPF in the previous quarter. Not a monthly return of tax on essential purchases.
programmes.deadline_note: Paid quarterly (last business day of April, July and October per the service page); on the Cartão Cidadão or via PIX/Banrisul account. Eligible families are those in CadUnico.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
Access the Devolve ICMS portal/app with gov.br login to check amounts
Receive monthly payments in the registered account

documents_required.doc: Bank account in the name of the family representative

eligibility.income_note: CadUnico families that receive Bolsa Família or have a dependent in the state regular high school, with family income up to 3 national minimum wages (R$ 4.863/month = R$ 58.356/year) or per-person income below half a minimum wage.

programmes.source_snippet: As famílias beneficiárias recebem, no mínimo, R$ 400 por ano, pagos em quatro parcelas trimestrais de R$ 100.

programmes.name_en: Renda Mais DF - income complement of the Federal District
programmes.funder: Governo do Distrito Federal - Secretaria de Desenvolvimento Social (SEDES)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly state income complement for families in poverty and extreme poverty of the Distrito Federal registered in CadÚnico, paid on the Cartão Social DF; values set by district rules, complementing Bolsa Família.
programmes.deadline_note: Ended: no programme named 'Renda Mais DF' appears on SEDES-DF or in the Distrito Federal budget plan; the district's income-transfer programme is Programa DF Social (CadUnico, per-person income below half a minimum wage).

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS of the DF
SEDES selects eligible families automatically
Receive monthly on the Cartão Social DF

documents_required.doc: Proof of residence in the Distrito Federal

eligibility.income_note: Families in poverty/extreme poverty residing in the Distrito Federal and registered in CadÚnico

programmes.source_snippet: Renda para seleção: Renda per capita mensal inferior a 1/2 salário mínimo vigente

programmes.name_en: Travessia - Minas Gerais grant for families in homelessness situations
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado de Minas Gerais - Secretaria de Desenvolvimento Social (SEDESE)
programmes.amount_note: State social-development programme (launched 2008, Sedese) delivered through agreements with municipalities in localities with concentrations of socially vulnerable families, to promote their inclusion. Official pages do not publish an individual monthly cash grant of R$ 400 or a rent aid for homeless families.
programmes.deadline_note: No individual application: the programme is operated through Sedese agreements with municipalities; ask the municipal social assistance network (CRAS).

procedure_steps.detail: Seek the CRAS/CREAS or Centro Pop of your municipality
Social evaluation confirms street/homeless situation
Receive the monthly aid while following the social accompaniment plan

documents_required.doc: CPF and documents of the family

eligibility.income_note: Families in socially vulnerable localities covered by municipal agreements with Sedese; no individual income ceiling is published.

programmes.source_snippet: Lançado em 2008 e coordenado pela Secretaria de Estado de Desenvolvimento Social (Sedese), o Programa Travessia promove a inclusão social e

programmes.name_local: Isenção de IPVA para Pessoa com Deficiência (PCD)
programmes.name_en: Vehicle tax (IPVA) exemption for persons with disabilities
programmes.funder: Secretarias estaduais da Fazenda (ex.: SP, RJ, MG, PR, RS, DF e demais estados)
programmes.amount_note: São Paulo state IPVA exemption for vehicles of persons with disabilities or autism: no IPVA in years when the vehicle's market value is below R$ 70 mil; between R$ 70 mil and R$ 120 mil you pay IPVA only on the difference. (Other states' rules are not covered by this record.)
programmes.deadline_note: Request through the SP Finance Department (Sefaz-SP) with medical documentation and a declaration in SIVEI that no other vehicle is exempt; follow the protocol and payment rules in the year of the request.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the rules of your state's Secretaria da Fazenda
Submit the exemption request with medical report and vehicle documents
After approval, license the vehicle without IPVA

documents_required.doc: Medical report proving the disability (per state rules)
Vehicle documents in the name of the PCD or legal representative

eligibility.income_note: No income test; person with disability/autism as defined by São Paulo state rules; vehicle value limit R$ 120 mil.

programmes.source_snippet: No ano em que o valor venal do veículo estiver abaixo de R$70 mil: não é necessário pagar o IPVA do ano

programmes.name_local: Isenção de IPTU para Aposentados e Idosos (Município de São Paulo)
programmes.name_en: Property tax (IPTU) exemption for low-income retirees and seniors - city of São Paulo
programmes.funder: Prefeitura de São Paulo - Secretaria Municipal da Fazenda
programmes.amount_note: Full IPTU exemption if monthly income is up to 3 minimum wages, partial exemption between 3 and 5 minimum wages, for retirees, pensioners and INSS lifetime-income/elderly social assistance beneficiaries who live in their only property (market value up to R$ 1.823.697,00) in São Paulo city.
programmes.deadline_note: Electronic request in the SIIA system until the last business day of the year of the tax event (retirees who must file IRPF can request only after the Receita filing deadline); results published in the Diário Oficial da Cidade.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility (income and property value ceilings) at the Prefeitura SP Fazenda portal
Submit the exemption request online or at a Subprefeitura with documents
Exemption applies to the following IPTU bills while conditions hold

documents_required.doc: IPTU bill / property registration in the applicant's name

eligibility.income_note: Monthly income (benefit, investments, any income) up to 3 minimum wages (R$ 4.863) for full exemption and up to 5 minimum wages (R$ 8.105/month = R$ 97.260/year) for partial exemption; no other property in Brazil; property value up to R$ 1.823.697.

programmes.source_snippet: Rendimento mensal (benefício, investimentos, rendas em geral) que não ultrapasse 3 (três) salários mínimos no exercício a que se refere o pedido, para isenção total;

programmes.name_local: Auxílio Moradia / Aluguel Social (Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte)
programmes.name_en: Social rent aid - municipality of Belo Horizonte
programmes.funder: Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte - Secretaria Municipal de Política Urbana / SMADC
programmes.amount_note: Bolsa Moradia: R$ 800,00 per month rent subsidy for families removed by public works, disaster victims, families in precarious housing in risk areas or irregular occupations, and homeless families; the beneficiary finds a property that Urbel inspects before the lease.
programmes.deadline_note: Referral by Urbel (removals for works/risk) or by the Subsecretaria de Assistência Social (homeless families); send the original rent receipt by the 25th of each month.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the regional URA/housing secretariat of BH
Social evaluation confirms vulnerability or removal situation
Receive monthly rent aid while awaiting housing solution

documents_required.doc: Proof of the situation (risk area, removal, vulnerability)

eligibility.income_note: Eligibility is by situation (removal for public works, calamity, risk area/irregular occupation, homeless), not by an income ceiling; the homeless route also needs CadUnico and about two years' residence in Belo Horizonte (PBH news).

programmes.source_snippet: O valor do benefício é de R$ 800,00. O recibo original que comprova o pagamento do aluguel deve ser encaminhado até o dia 25 do mês.

programmes.name_local: Gratuidade no Transporte Intermunicipal para Idosos 65+ (EMTU/SP)
programmes.name_en: Free intermunicipal transport for seniors 65+ in São Paulo state (EMTU)
programmes.funder: Governo do Estado de São Paulo - EMTU e empresas concessionárias intermunicipais
programmes.amount_note: Free travel on EMTU intermunicipal bus lines for people aged 65 or over (metropolitan São Paulo, Baixada Santista, Campinas), with ID.
programmes.deadline_note: No application needed for people aged 65+: board free by showing photo ID (RG); the TOP Sênior card is optional. People aged 60-65 can use the electronic ticket on EMTU lines.

procedure_steps.detail: Issue the Bilhete Único Idoso/EMTU at an authorised post with ID and photo
Use free intermunicipal EMTU lines

documents_required.doc: Proof of residence in São Paulo state

eligibility.income_note: All persons aged 65+ on EMTU intermunicipal lines of São Paulo state

programmes.source_snippet: Para idosos com 65 anos de idade ou mais, o cartão do idoso não é obrigatório. O embarque pode ser feito gratuitamente com a apresentação do RG

programmes.name_local: Programa Aprendiz Legal / Jovem Aprendiz (Lei da Aprendizagem)
programmes.name_en: Apprenticeship programme - first formal job for youth 14-24
programmes.funder: Empresas de médio e grande porte (Lei nº 10.097/2000); fiscalizado pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego
programmes.amount_note: Guaranteed wage of at least the hourly minimum wage, FGTS, 13th salary and paid vacation for apprentices aged 14-24 hired under the apprenticeship contract (quota of 5%-15% of positions in medium/large companies).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply for apprentice vacancies at companies and institutions (CIEE, Senac, Senai, Espro and company portals).

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol in an apprenticeship course (CIEE, Senac, Senai, Espro, Rede Nacional de Aprendizagem)
Apply for apprentice vacancies in companies
Sign the apprenticeship contract with all labour rights

documents_required.doc: CPF, ID and school enrolment certificate

eligibility.income_note: Youth aged 14-24, preferably enrolled in school; no income test (some courses prioritise low-income youth)

programmes.source_snippet: Instituída pela Lei nº 10.097, de 19 de dezembro de 2000, a contratação de aprendizes é destinada a adolescentes e jovens entre 14 anos completos e 24 anos incompletos.
